external_entities.name: other teams' backends
external_entities.description: Backends operated by other teams that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

external_entities.name: calling team's users
external_entities.description: Users of the calling teams whose typed prompts may be included in requests.
external_entities.source_excerpt: raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: People who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
external_entities.notes: The source is uncertain about what governs who can push and suggests a shared group account: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: The gateway receives API keys in request headers. Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.notes: The source says artifact integrity is not believed to be verified: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that may contain user-entered text.
data_stores.source_excerpt: an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call inference
data_flows.description: Other teams' backends call the inference gateway with inference requests.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header.

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for access. The source says it does not believe artifact swapping is verified.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store
data_flows.data_description: Customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response to the inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.notes: Raw prompts may be included in the logged requests.
data_flows.data_description: Every request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
data_flows.notes: Authentication and authorization are unknown. The source says: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store. It is intended to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The gateway is described as a FastAPI service exposed on the internet; FastAPI is an HTTP web application framework.

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the store contains customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer; disclosure of such customer-related and spending information could harm a person or the business.
